type Identified = { id: number };
type User = Identified & { name: string };
type Product = Identified & { price: number };
type Id<T extends User | Product> = T["id"];
type Label<T extends (Identified & { x: number }) | (Identified & { y: number }) | (Identified & { z: number })> =
  T["id"];
const id: Id<User> = 1;
const label: Label<Identified & { x: number }> = 2;
console.log(id, label);
